name: Takashima (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Takashima town emblem in black: an outlined ring enclosing a five-pointed star and a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Takashima in Hokkaido, dissolved on 1940-04-01.

features.role: Takashima town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a five-pointed star and a stylised character
